name: Plot
summary: Draw a bar chart from numbers, inline.
description: Give it numbers - `3, 7, 2, 8` or labelled `mon: 3, tue: 7` (one per line or comma-separated) - and it renders a bar chart in the channel. Type `/plot 3, 7, 2`, or write a `chart` code block and press Run. The chart is drawn as a scene, so it looks native in light and dark.

changes: Skips values that are not finite numbers, and large labels are no longer cut off.
Negative values are drawn as bars below a zero line.

author: slim-m

extension_points.name: bars
extension_points.description: Render a bar chart from numbers.
